title: Public proposal link
description: Expose a read-only public proposal view through a deterministic share link.
constraints: No file storage or email delivery is introduced.
acceptanceCriteria: A proposal can generate a public share token.
The public view loads proposal summary data by token.
Expired or invalid links show a clear error.
The public page avoids exposing internal-only fields.
The UI renders line items and totals.
Focused tests cover valid, expired and invalid link cases.
expectedConflictNotes: Public view and link service share proposal visibility rules.
Tests depend on token expiry and public data filtering.
